blocks.text: Modem local network ko Internet Service Provider (ISP, Internet dene wali company) se jorta hai. Yeh digital data ko aise signals mein convert (badalta) karta hai jo transmission (line par bhejne) ke qabil hon. Yeh aane wale signals ko wapas digital shakal mein bhi badalta hai. Modems cable, DSL ya fiber connections ke saath istemal hote hain. Internet access (Internet tak pohanch) modem par depend karti hai. Modems aksar routers ke saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Ustad signal badalne ki misaal se modem samjhayein. Talaba us ka khulasa (summary) likhein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: "Modem" do lafzon se bana hai: MOdulator (digital data ko line ke signal mein badalna) aur DEModulator (signal ko wapas digital data mein badalna).

blocks.explanation: 1) Bhejte waqt digital data ko line ke signals mein badalna. 2) Aane wale signals ko wapas digital data mein badalna. Is tarah local network ISP se jurta hai.

items: Modem: local network ko ISP se jorta hai; digital data ko signal mein aur signal ko digital mein badalta hai.
